## 2. Authorized Medical Attendants  
1. A Department of the Central Government or Head of Department as specified in SR 2 (10) is empowered to appoint Medical Officers under the employ of the Central Government, State Governments and Union Territories, as also Medical Officers not in Government employ, i.e., private registered medical practitioners as Authorized Medical Attendants.
